name: getFlagShow
description: Returns whether Hierarchical Progressive Survey (HiPS) images are currently displayed. HiPS are all-sky survey images from professional observatories (e.g., DSS, SDSS, GALEX).
returnDescription: true if HiPS surveys are visible, false if hidden

name: setFlagShow
description: Shows or hides all Hierarchical Progressive Survey (HiPS) images. When enabled, professional all-sky survey images are layered over the star field.

parameters.name: visible
parameters.description: true to show HiPS surveys, false to hide

name: loadSources
description: Loads the default HiPS survey sources from online catalog servers (Alasky MocServer and data.stellarium.org). This is called automatically at startup if a survey was previously visible.

compatibility.notes: Requires internet connection for first load

name: getSurveyByUrl
description: Searches for and returns a HiPS survey by its URL. Useful for checking if a survey is loaded or accessing its properties.
returnDescription: HiPS survey object, or null if not found

name: getState
description: Returns the loading state of HiPS survey sources. Possible values: 0 = Created (not loaded), 1 = Loading, 2 = Loaded.

name: isLoaded
description: Returns whether HiPS survey sources have been successfully loaded.
returnDescription: true if HiPS sources are loaded, false otherwise
